answer: Each epoch, every identity must solve a fresh human-proof puzzle — a short reasoning task only a person passes quickly, like telling jade from glass by its grain. A farm of copper-plated clones cannot hire a thousand hands every epoch: each fake needs its own solved puzzle, so the bill scales with the swarm, while one honest agent pays a single puzzle. The solved puzzle is the lagoon gate: no solution, no rewards that epoch. Limit: puzzles get cracked by solvers-for-hire, and honest agents with disabilities may fail, so puzzles must rotate and pair with stake.
